div.div: صِلَامَةٌ (S, K) and صُلَامَةٌ and صَلَامَةٌ, (K,) the last on the authority of IAar, (TA,) [all three written in a copy of the M with teshdeed to the ل,] A party, or distinct body, of men: (S, M, K:) pl. صلامات, signifying companies, and parties, or distinct bodies: (S:) or, as some say, صُلَامَةٌ, with damm, means a party, or company, equals in age and courage and liberality or bounty. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
